review.assessment: The change creates `src/lib.rs` by introducing a nested loop algorithm that runs in $O(N 	imes K)$ time. The task explicitly requires an efficient solution running in roughly linear time ($O(N)$), which this implementation fails to provide for large inputs and large windows.
